review_candidates.title: FBS Production Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a FBS Production Support Engineer based in Brazil. We are seeking an experienced Production Support Engineer to ensure the stability, reliability, and performance of critical enterprise applications supporting direct sales and customer contact center operations. In this role, you will take ownership of complex production incidents, lead root cause investigations, and coordinate effective resolutions to minimize business disruption. You will work closely with business stakeholders, contact center leadership, and cross-functional IT teams to maintain seamless application operations. Leveraging your expertise in Salesforce, APIs, databases, integrations, and monitoring tools, you will proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement. You will also contribute to operational excellence through automation, documentation, and preventive measures. This is an opportunity to play a key technical role in a large-scale insurance and financial services environment. Accountabilities Coordinate and lead incident response activities, ensuring timely resolution and clear communication with relevant business and technical stakeholders. Act as the primary escalation point for complex production support issues, taking ownership of high-priority incidents and driving them through to resolution. Monitor production environments using observability and monitoring tools to proactively identify system anomalies, performance issues, and operational risks. Lead root cause analysis for critical incidents, implement permanent corrective actions, and conduct post-incident reviews to prevent recurrence. Collaborate with Direct Sales teams, contact center leadership, and cross-functional IT stakeholders to assess business impact and coordinate resolution plans. Provide clear and timely updates on incident status, business impact, technical findings, and expected resolution timelines. Identify recurring production issues and recommend improvements to application reliability, support processes, and operational efficiency. Develop and maintain technical documentation, operational runbooks, troubleshooting procedures, and support knowledge resources. Identify opportunities to automate repetitive support activities and improve production operations. Review and approve system changes affecting production environments and validate testing activities before deployment. Analyze application architecture, APIs, middleware, databases, system integrations, and data flows to diagnose and resolve technical issues. Support implementation activities and provide technical guidance to business and IT stakeholders. Mentor junior team members, share technical knowledge, and promote production support best practices. Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline. 4–6 years of overall IT experience, including 4–6 years in application support, application development, system analysis, or production support environments. Proven experience managing production incidents and troubleshooting enterprise applications. Strong understanding of application architecture, APIs, system integrations, databases, and data flows. Hands-on experience with application monitoring and observability platforms. Experience working with Salesforce in an enterprise or production support environment. Strong incident management and problem-solving capabilities, including root cause analysis and permanent remediation. Familiarity with change management, production deployment validation, and system integration support. Knowledge of Dynatrace or comparable monitoring tools is an advantage. Understanding of ITIL processes and incident and problem management practices is preferred. Experience working in large enterprise environments is beneficial. Excellent communication skills in English, with the ability to explain technical issues and business impact to both technical and non-technical audiences. Strong ownership, analytical thinking, collaboration, and prioritization skills. Benefits Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. Comprehensive benefits package, including grocery vouchers, savings funds, and other applicable benefits. Private health insurance. Pension plan. Paid time off. Career development and professional training opportunities. Opportunity to work within a dynamic and inclusive international environment. Benefits may vary depending on employee level.
